create_interval_thread: create an Interval thread that executes a callable function at a specified time interval
run_interval_with_count: run an Interval thread that executes a function a fixed number of times at set intervals
cancel_interval_thread: cancel a running Interval thread to stop periodic function execution
pause_and_unpause_interval: pause and unpause an Interval thread to temporarily halt and resume execution
create_daemon_interval_thread: create a daemon Interval thread that runs a function periodically in the background
